summary: Retest of iter71 action items. Both fixes verified green. (1) Frontend: Download Statement (PDF) button at /retailer/b2b/rewards is now enabled for empty-ledger retailers (disabled expression simplified to `disabled={downloading}`). E2E confirmed via Playwright with a minted retailer_session for RTL_DELHI001 (0 ledger entries): button is clickable, click triggered a valid 3436-byte PDF starting with %PDF and ending with %%EOF. Empty-state placeholder 'No entries in this filter yet...' renders as expected. (2) Backend: CSV export at GET /api/admin/b2b/inventory/log/export.csv now guards against non-ISO created_at rows with `if 'T' in ts_raw` conditional. Verified by inserting a synthetic b2b_inventory_log row with created_at='2026-02-11' (date-only, no T) — CSV export returns 200, includes the row, and preserves the raw timestamp. No IndexError. (3) Regression: all iter71 tests still green — admin CSV headers intact (11 columns matching spec), /log list endpoint returns 200 with entries (route-order fix persists), retailer statement PDF still returns valid %PDF. Test suites: 6/6 iter71 integration cases pass, 5/5 new iter72 retest cases pass. Total 11/11.
critical_code_review_comments: Optional hardening: `admin_inventory_log_csv` could use `datetime.fromisoformat(ts_raw)` with try/except to normalize timestamps into a consistent display format rather than passing raw non-ISO strings through, but current fix is spec-compliant (accountants get the row without a crash).
The frontend `disabled={downloading}` still short-circuits during in-flight downloads to prevent double-clicks — good. No regression.
